displayAddress: Sylvan Court, Fitzroy Road, Stoke, Plymouth
description:
SUMMARY  ***A stylish and spacious two-bedroom apartment featuring a bright, light-filled lounge and diner with a feature fireplace, a contemporary fitted kitchen, a master bedroom with an en-suite, a separate family bathroom, secure intercom access, communal gardens, and allocated parking.*** 

LOCATION  Sylvan Court is well placed for Plymouth city centre, Mutley Plain and North Hill, providing easy access to shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities. Plymouth's main transport links are also within convenient reach, making the property a practical choice for those commuting or travelling around the city. 

DESCRIPTION  Upon entering the property, you are immediately welcomed into a welcoming and exceptionally spacious reception hallway, complete with a secure entry intercom system that sets a tone of comfort and security.
To the left of the hallway lies a well-appointed, contemporary fitted kitchen. This functional culinary space is comprehensively equipped with a built-in electric hob, a matching oven, and an overhead extractor unit. Thoughtfully designed to accommodate modern living, the kitchen also benefits from dedicated plumbing for a washing machine, ample room for additional freestanding white goods, and a bright double-glazed window that allows natural light to fill the room.
Positioned to the right of the entrance is a magnificent, generously proportioned lounge and dining area. This impressive reception room is flooded with natural light, creating a bright and airy ambiance ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. A striking feature electric fire, elegantly framed by a decorative wooden mantel, serves as a cosy focal point. Comfort is further enhanced by an electric storage heater and a large double-glazed window overlooking the surroundings.
The accommodation continues into the master bedroom, a substantial double retreat designed to offer ample space for freestanding or fitted wardrobes. This tranquil sanctuary features a double-glazed window and an efficient electric radiator, alongside the added convenience of a private en-suite shower room. The en-suite is finished to a high standard, comprising a modern three-piece suite with a single shower cubicle, a low-level WC, and a wash-hand basin. It is further complemented by stylish wall tiling, a double-glazed window, and an integrated wall heater.
The second bedroom is equally impressive in size, easily accommodating a double bed and offering versatile living arrangements for guests, family members, or a home office. It is served by a double-glazed window and an electric radiator. A separate, well-proportioned family bathroom mirrors the quality of the en-suite, featuring a matching three-piece suite that includes a panelled bath, WC, and wash-hand basin, complete with complementary finishes and a wall-mounted heater.
Externally, residents can enjoy access to beautifully maintained communal gardens, offering a tranquil outdoor space to unwind. The property is further enhanced by the valuable addition of one allocated parking space, ensuring both convenience and peace of mind.
